name: Deprecation Status
description: Shows data about deprecation status of drupal.org projects.
project_description: Deprecation Status displays the results of the Drupal Association's regular Project Analysis report, which scans contributed drupal.org projects for deprecated API uses and major-version (Drupal 11 / Drupal 12) readiness. The module ships the report data as CSV files and renders it as interactive summary, project, error and chart pages so maintainers and contribution-event participants can act on the results. It is a developer/community-analysis tool for the whole ecosystem rather than a scanner for a single site (use Upgrade Status for your own site). An admin route can refresh the shipped dataset by downloading the latest CSVs from the module's own git.drupalcode.org repository, and a REST resource exposes the raw CSV data as JSON.
